name: Haunter (CobbleEffort form)
look: a round red head with two curved horns, one glaring eye and a jagged mouth trailing a long blue ghost tongue, flame wings and two floating clawed hands
entry: It licks its prey with its long, ice-cold blue tongue, and the victim shivers even as the flames on its sides scorch the grass. Its floating hands can grab you from across a room.
how: Wild: rare in badlands, deserts and savannas at night, and the Nether.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Gengar when traded.
